entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need a return label. Order number 774-B-91.
Certainly. Let me pull that up. I see an order for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I can definitely help you with that. Just so I have it for my records, can I get your name please?
Jane Doe. Just send the label to the email on file.

Okay, Jane. I'm looking at your order, delivered on December 16th, so about 30 days ago. To proceed, I just need to ask, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's neither. I tried to return this on day nine, but your website was down. I just want the label I should have gotten then.
I understand. So you're saying you encountered a website error when you initiated the return? Let me just check our system status logs for that period.
Yes. The entire returns portal was offline. It means I couldn't print anything. I have a screenshot of the error page if you need proof.

That won't be necessary, Jane, but thank you for offering. I'm looking at our internal alerts and I see you are correct. Our entire system was down for several hours on December 25th due to a server issue. I sincerely apologize that you were impacted by that.
Let me just confirm the policy here... okay. It looks like your purchase is eligible for return within 10 days.

Absolutely. Given that it was our system down that prevented the original return, I've gone ahead and approved this for a full refund. The prepaid shipping label has just been sent to your email. You should see it in the next few minutes.

You're very welcome. And Jane, I see here that you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble our website error caused you, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account. We appreciate your business and I'm sorry again for the hassle.
A credit? Fine. That's good. Thanks.
Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
